{{Actor|name=ovl_En_Ex_Item|ispage=true}}

'''ovl_En_Ex_Item''' is the [[actor]] used for displaying and possibly obtaining items from the Slingshot Minigame that Child Link can play in the Lost Woods, and [[Bombchu Bowling]].

{{clear}}
